players.bio: Akeel Adriano Billy Higgins (born 24 July 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or left winger for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. Club career West Bromwich Albion Higgins signed his first professional contract with West Bromwich Albion on 7 July 2023.
Archie Andrew Philip Harris is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. He is a Wales under-21 international.
Bradley-Paul Burrowes is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa.

Callum Henry McManaman (born 25 April 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One side Wigan Athletic. Born in Whiston, Merseyside, lived and brought up in Rainhill, Merseyside, McManaman began his youth career at Everton before being released in 2007 and joining Wigan Athletic.
Charlie George Gray is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic, on loan from Premier League club Manchester City.
Christopher John Bernard Sze (born 9 December 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One side Wigan Athletic.

Christian Nyensuah Saydee (born 10 May 2002) is an English footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. Career Early career A youth product of Pro Touch SA and Reading, Saydee moved to Bournemouth's academy at the age of 16. AFC Bournemouth Saydee started his career with English Premier League side Bournemouth.
Connor Ellis Barrett (born 1 March 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays for Wigan Athletic as a right-back.

Dara James Morgan Costelloe (born 11 December 2002) is an Irish footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. He has previously played for Galway United and Burnley, and has also played on loan for Bradford City, St Johnstone, Dundee, Accrington Stanley and Northampton Town.
Finley Jack Burns is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic.

Fraser Murray (born 7 May 1999) is a Scottish footballer who plays for Wigan Athletic. Murray was given his first team debut for Hibernian in a 2016–17 Scottish Challenge Cup tie against Highland League club Turriff United, in September 2016. Murray was selected for the Scotland under-19 squad in November 2017.

Gary Caldwell (born 12 April 1987) is a Scottish former professional footballer and coach who is the current head coach of EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. Caldwell played for Newcastle United, Darlington, Coventry City, Derby County, Hibernian, Celtic, Wigan Athletic and won 55 international caps for Scotland.
James Lee Carragher (born 11 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic.

Jensen Guy Weir (born 31 January 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Wigan Athletic. He began his career at Wigan Athletic, before joining Brighton & Hove Albion in 2020, where he has spent loan spells at Cambridge United, Morecambe and Blackpool.
Jeremiah Chukwuedo Chilokoa-Mullen is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic.
Joseph Charles Whitworth is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic.

Jon Mellish is an English professional footballer who plays as a versatile defender and midfielder for Wigan Athletic. Mellish began his career with Gateshead, making his senior debut during the 2016–17 season. He moved on loan to Newcastle Benfield in November 2017. He signed for Carlisle United in May 2019.
Joe Anthony Walsh (born 1 April 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper Wigan Athletic.
K'Marni Leigh Miller is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic.

Luke Harris is a 21-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic, on loan from Premier League club Fulham. He has spent time on loan at Exeter City, Birmingham City and Oxford United. He has represented Wales from under-17 to under-21 level.

Max McAuley Power is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. He began his career with Tranmere Rovers and then spent time with Wigan Athletic and Sunderland, making more than 100 Football League appearances with each club, before rejoining Wigan in 2021.

Morgan Alexander Fox is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. Fox began his career with Charlton Athletic and became a regular in the first team in the 2014–15 season after gaining experience on loan at Notts County. He made 116 appearances for the Addicks before joining Sheffield Wednesday in January 2017.
Reggie Spencer Walsh (born 20 October 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic, on loan from Premier League club Chelsea.

Ryan Thomas Lowe (born 18 September 1978) is an English professional football coach and former player, who is currently head coach of EFL League One side Wigan Athletic. His playing career, as a striker, began at Burscough in 1999 and he became a Football League player with Shrewsbury Town the following year. He played for eight league clubs in all and had three spells at Bury.

Ryan Joseph Trevitt is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. Trevitt began his professional career with Brentford in 2021 and was promoted into the first team squad in 2023. Trevitt began his professional career with Brentford in 2021 and was promoted into the first team squad in 2023.

Scott Andrew Hogan is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One side Wigan Athletic. Hogan played in the youth system at Rochdale but was released in 2010 Hogan played in the youth system at Rochdale but was released in 2010.

Sonny Tufail Perkins (born 10 February 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic. In 2019, Perkins joined West Ham United from Leyton Orient at under-15 level.
Tom Watson (born 27 August 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Wigan Athletic.
